scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
Hey, you're carrying
way too much stuff. Why don't you stash it away in Kafra Storage? We can talk after you do that, right?
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
嘿，你带的东西太多了，先存进卡普拉仓库吧。
存好我们再聊，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
My name is Jaax.
Without ego, I can
say that I am perhaps the
^663300greatest inventor of our time^000000.
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
我叫贾克斯。
毫不自夸地说，我或许是^663300这个时代最伟大的发明家^000000。

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
This time, I've
created something
truly extraordinary. I call them... ^663300Magic Quivers^000000 !! This will be remembered in history as an
arrow revolution!
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
这次我创造了真正了不起的东西，叫作...^663300魔法箭筒^000000！！
这将是一场载入史册的箭矢革命！

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
I've studied magic and quivers for years, working night and day until I finally figured how to condense arrows with magic! With magic quivers, you'll be carrying more arrows, but with less weight!
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
我研究魔法和箭筒多年，日夜钻研，终于掌握了用魔法压缩箭矢的方法！
使用魔法箭筒，就能带更多箭矢，负重却更低！

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
Would you like to try using one of my arrow quivers? I have no doubt that someone like you can appreciate my genius!
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
你想试试使用我的箭筒吗？我毫不怀疑，像你这样的人一定能欣赏我的天才！

scripts.text: Quiver
scripts.translation: 箭筒

scripts.text: Iron Arrow Quiver
scripts.translation: 铁箭矢筒

scripts.text: Steel Arrow Quiver
scripts.translation: 钢铁箭矢筒

scripts.text: Oridecon Arrow Quiver
scripts.translation: 神之金属箭矢筒

scripts.text: Fire Arrow Quiver
scripts.translation: 火箭矢筒

scripts.text: Silver Arrow Quiver
scripts.translation: 银箭矢筒

scripts.text: Wind Arrow Quiver
scripts.translation: 风灵箭矢筒

scripts.text: Stone Arrow Quiver
scripts.translation: 地灵箭矢筒

scripts.text: Crystal Arrow Quiver
scripts.translation: 水灵箭矢筒

scripts.text: Shadow Arrow Quiver
scripts.translation: 影子箭矢筒

scripts.text: Immaterial Arrow Quiver
scripts.translation: 无形箭矢筒

scripts.text: Rusty Arrow Quiver
scripts.translation: 铁锈箭矢筒

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
You can carry a maximum of 500 Arrows within this quiver. It was made using my secret method,
so the total weight of the Arrows and Quiver is less than carrying the Arrows alone.
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
这只箭袋最多能装500支箭。这是我用秘法制作的，因此箭和箭袋加起来，比单独携带这些箭还轻。

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
Excellent!
Are you carrying any Arrows with you? I'll provide you with a quiver that can carry 500 of your {0}s for only ^FF3131500 Zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
太好了！
您带箭了吗？我可以提供箭袋，里面装有500支{0}，只要^FF3131500 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text: Store as many Arrows in quivers as possible
scripts.translation: 尽量多购买箭筒

scripts.text: Purchase 1 quiver
scripts.translation: 购买1个箭筒

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
There you go!
Just remember, ^FF0000you won't be able to use the Quiver when your carried weight is 90% of your maximum weight limit^000000.
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
给您！
请记住，^FF0000当您的负重达到最大负重限制的90%时，将无法使用箭筒^000000。

scripts.text:
Number of
Arrows: ^3131FF{0} ^000000
Maximum Number
of Purchasable
Quivers: ^3131FF{1} ^000000
Zeny required: ^3131FF{2} Zeny^000000

[Inventor Jaax]
Would you like to
buy as many Quivers
as you can for the Arrows
you are currently carrying?
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
要按你现有的箭矢数量，尽量多购买箭筒吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
It's a miracle of science! One that you can experience for yourself if you bring me at least 500 Arrows and 500 Zeny for each Quiver.
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
这简直是科学的奇迹！只要您带来至少500支箭，并为每只箭袋准备500 Zeny，就能亲身体验。

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
What...?
Do you not see that this invention can forever change the way Arrows are carried?! The future is now!
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
什么...？
您难道没看到这项发明将永远改变箭矢的携带方式吗？！未来已来！

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
You don't even
have 500 Zeny?
I'm so sorry. I had no
idea that you were so...
^333333Destitute^000000.
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
您连
500 Zeny都没有吗？
真抱歉，我完全不知道您竟然这么...
^333333贫困^000000。

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
So...
Just keep track
of how much you're
carrying from time
to time and you should
be alright.
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
所以...时不时留意一下负重，就没问题了。

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
I'm sorry, but you don't have enough Zeny. I can't just give these away after working years
to develop this revolutionary technology!
scripts.translation:

抱歉，你的Zeny不够。
我花了多年才研发出这项革命性技术，可不能白送！

a quiver is so close?

idea that you were so...

^333333贫困^000000。

So...

of how much you're
carrying from time
to time and you should
be alright.

您难道没看到这项发明将永远改变箭矢的携带方式吗？！未来已来！

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
You don't even
have 500 Zeny?
I'm so sorry. I had no
idea that you were so...
^333333Destitute^000000.
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
您连
500 Zeny都没有吗？
真抱歉，我完全不知道您竟然这么...
^333333贫困^000000。

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
So...
Just keep track
of how much you're
carrying from time
to time and you should
be alright.
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
所以...时不时留意一下负重，就没问题了。

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
I'm sorry, but you don't have enough Zeny. I can't just give these away after working years
to develop this revolutionary technology!
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
抱歉，你的Zeny不够。
我花了多年才研发出这项革命性技术，可不能白送！

scripts.text:
[Inventor Jaax]
You changed your mind?
When the glory of owning
a quiver is so close?
scripts.translation:
[发明家 贾克斯]
改主意了？
拥有箭筒的荣耀都近在眼前了啊！
